scenes.title: DO YOU WANT TO START THE SYSTEM?

lines.t:
CHAPTER 3
The System Awakens
Beeping. White light. The smell of antiseptic.
Hospital… I'm alive?
A translucent blue window flickers into existence in front of his eyes. It floats there, perfectly still, no matter where he looks.
What… is that?
Footsteps in the corridor. Someone is coming.
Hide it — how do I hide it?! Close— go away—
His hand jerks up in panic and brushes straight through the glowing panel.
DO YOU WANT TO START THE SYSTEM?
Confirmed. The Transcendent System is initialising… Host synchronisation: 4%.
I… pressed YES?
The window vanishes just as the door opens.
Peter! Oh, thank goodness—
She hugs him so tightly it hurts. He doesn't complain.
What happened in that jungle? The teachers said they found you in sealed ruins. Who did this to you?

choice.t: "I don't remember. I just… woke up here."
"I got lost and fell. It's a blur."

lines.t: I really don't remember, Mom.
Elena studies his face for a long moment — the way she used to study villains.
…Okay. Okay. You're safe. That's what matters.
I brought your favourites. Nurse Aiko says you have to eat everything. I said I'd check.
Hey. You look terrible. I brought the emergency sandwich. It's a little squashed.
Thanks, John.
What happened in there? The teachers won't tell us anything. Bruce is saying you went in to cry.
I don't really remember. Honestly.
…Okay. But when you do remember, I'm the first to know. Deal?
Deal.
Evening. The ward is quiet.
WOULD YOU LIKE TO ACCEPT YOUR FIRST QUEST?
The System will wait. The System is patient. The host's heart rate suggests curiosity.
WOULD YOU LIKE TO ACCEPT YOUR FIRST QUEST?
Quest accepted. THE TRANSCENDENT SYSTEM IS NOW ACTIVE.
Only you can see this interface. Nobody else can detect it.
Status, Quests, Cards and more are available from the SYSTEM button.
A system. Quests. Like a game…
Okay. Let's play.

scenes.title: Going Home

lines.t: Your recovery is… honestly ridiculous. Two days ago you were in pieces. Go home before the doctors start writing papers about you.
Come on, you. Home.
Home. His own bed. His own posters. And the blue glow only he can see.
Tip: Open SYSTEM → Status to allocate stat points. Open Cards to view abilities. Daily quests arrive every morning.
Back to school tomorrow. And this time… I'm not the same.

scenes.hint: Complete 'Rise Again' in the hospital (eat, walk the corridor, breathing exercises), then sleep.
